A '''cortosis mine''' was in use by the [[Jin'ha]] located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obredaan]] specifically for the use of synthesizing [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] ore for use in their weapons.

==Description==
Immediately to the right of the mine entrance was a landing pad with an inactive [[Jin'ha starship]]. Two sets of doors led into a large room with various crates, a small sunken pit of lethal liquid near the back of the room, and a set of stairs that led to a second floor. Several corridors eventually led to an elevator room, where occupants can descend further into the facility. At the lowest point of the mine is a large room with a cortosis refinery.<ref name="Obi Wan" />

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were sent on a mission to Obredaan by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to investigate the system after they had [[Skirmishes on Coruscant|prevented]] a war on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had been started by the criminal gang [[Black Heth]], whom at the time were being supplied in arms by the Jin'ha. While Jinn had set off to search for the missing [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] who were lost during a [[First mission to Obredaan|previous]] mission, Kenobi infiltrated the facility and eventually recovered a sample of cortosis metal from the mine.<ref name="Obi Wan" />

Obi-Wan's eventual rendezvous with Jinn and the missing masters led to the discovery of a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation gunship|gunship]] as it flew overhead, leading the Jedi to believe a link existed between the Trade Federation and the Jin'ha.<ref name="Obi Wan" />
